title: Dialectica Promotes B2B Surveys and Due Diligence Capabilities in Early 2026
summary: Dialectica actively promotes its B2B Surveys product and due-diligence use cases in early 2026, positioning its high-curation expert matching and survey capabilities for private equity and corporate strategy clients.
whyItMatters: Dialectica's B2B survey push and due-diligence positioning signal the firm's strategy to capture PE and corporate strategy budgets.
